title.en: Book of Wei, Chapter 16 · Biography of Zheng Hun

text.en: Zheng Hun's great-great-grandfather Zheng Zhong, courtesy name Zishi, was a renowned Confucian scholar and Minister of Agriculture.
text.zht: 鄭渾的高祖父鄭衆，字子師，為著名儒者，官至大司農。
text.zhs: 郑浑的高祖父郑众，字子师，为著名儒者，官至大司农。

text.en: Zheng Zhong's father Zheng Xing, courtesy name Shaogan, was a renowned Confucian scholar and Counsellor Remonstrant.
text.zht: 鄭衆之父鄭興，字少贛，為著名儒者，官至諫議大夫。
text.zhs: 郑众之父郑兴，字少赣，为著名儒者，官至谏议大夫。

text.en: Zheng Hun's elder brother Zheng Tai plotted with Xun You and others to put Dong Zhuo to death.
text.zht: 鄭渾之兄鄭泰與荀攸等人合謀誅殺董卓。
text.zhs: 郑浑之兄郑泰与荀攸等人合谋诛杀董卓。

text.en: After Zheng Hun died, having been so frugal that his family went hungry and cold, his son Zheng Chong was appointed a Court Gentleman.
text.zht: 鄭渾去世時家境清貧，妻兒飢寒，其子鄭崇被任命為郎中。
text.zhs: 郑浑去世时家境清贫，妻儿饥寒，其子郑崇被任命为郎中。

text.en: Zheng Tai's young son Zheng Mao was taken by Zheng Hun to seek refuge in Huainan.
text.zht: 鄭泰之幼子鄭袤被鄭渾帶著一同逃往淮南。
text.zhs: 郑泰之幼子郑袤被郑浑带着一同逃往淮南。

text.en: Zheng Hun took his nephew Zheng Mao, Zheng Tai's young son, with him when he fled to Huainan and then across the Yangtze.
text.zht: 鄭渾帶著侄子鄭袤逃往淮南，後又渡江南下。
text.zhs: 郑浑带着侄子郑袤逃往淮南，后又渡江南下。

text.en: Zheng Tai told his friend Xun You that He Jin was not easy to assist, and plotted with him and others to put Dong Zhuo to death.
text.zht: 鄭泰對好友荀攸說何公難以輔佐，並與他等人合謀誅殺董卓。
text.zhs: 郑泰对好友荀攸说何公难以辅佐，并与他等人合谋诛杀董卓。

text.en: Zheng Tai was good friends with Hua Xin and Xun You.
text.zht: 鄭泰與華歆、荀攸交好。
text.zhs: 郑泰与华歆、荀攸交好。

text.en: On seeing Zheng Mao, Hua Xin exclaimed, "Zheng Gongye will not perish after all!"
text.zht: 華歆見到鄭袤，讚歎道：「鄭公業不死矣！」
text.zhs: 华歆见到郑袤，赞叹道：「郑公业不死矣！」

text.en: Knowing Yuan Shu was bound to fail, Zheng Hun crossed the Yangtze and joined Hua Xin, Grand Administrator of Yuzhang and a longtime friend of his elder brother, who took him in.
text.zht: 鄭渾知袁術必敗，渡江投奔豫章太守華歆，華歆與其兄鄭泰是舊友，收留了他。
text.zhs: 郑浑知袁术必败，渡江投奔豫章太守华歆，华歆与其兄郑泰是旧友，收留了他。

text.en: He Jin appointed Zheng Tai Imperial Secretariat Attendant Gentleman and Commandant of Imperial Carriages, but Zheng Tai's warning against summoning Dong Zhuo went unheeded, so he resigned and left, saying Lord He was not easy to assist.
text.zht: 何進任命鄭泰為尚書侍郎、奉車都尉，但鄭泰勸阻召董卓入京，何進不聽，鄭泰遂辭官而去，說何公難以輔佐。
text.zhs: 何进任命郑泰为尚书侍郎、奉车都尉，但郑泰劝阻召董卓入京，何进不听，郑泰遂辞官而去，说何公难以辅佐。

text.en: He Jin intended to execute the palace eunuchs and wished to summon Dong Zhuo to assist him.
text.zht: 何進打算誅殺宦官，想召董卓入京相助。
text.zhs: 何进打算诛杀宦官，想召董卓入京相助。

text.en: Zheng Tai talked Dong Zhuo out of a massive mobilisation against East of the Pass with ten arguments, and Dong Zhuo made him a general in command of the armies sent against it; when told he had ties with the east, Dong Zhuo took away his troops and kept him at court, and Zheng Tai later conspired with Wang Yun to kill him and fled east.
text.zht: 鄭泰以十條理由勸阻董卓大舉出兵關東，董卓遂任命他為將、統領東征之軍；有人說他與山東諸侯有聯繫，董卓便收回他的兵馬，將他留在朝中，鄭泰後來與王允合謀刺董，並逃出武關東去。
text.zhs: 郑泰以十条理由劝阻董卓大举出兵关东，董卓遂任命他为将、统领东征之军；有人说他与山东诸侯有联系，董卓便收回他的兵马，将他留在朝中，郑泰后来与王允合谋刺董，并逃出武关东去。

text.en: Zheng Tai later conspired with Wang Yun to kill Dong Zhuo, then escaped east through Wuguan.
text.zht: 鄭泰後來與王允合謀刺殺董卓，隨後逃出武關東去。
text.zhs: 郑泰后来与王允合谋刺杀董卓，随后逃出武关东去。

text.en: Yuan Shu, General of the Rear, appointed Zheng Tai Inspector of Yang Province, but he died on the way before taking office, aged forty-two.
text.zht: 後將軍袁術任命鄭泰為揚州刺史，他赴任途中去世，年四十二歲。
text.zhs: 后将军袁术任命郑泰为扬州刺史，他赴任途中去世，年四十二岁。

text.en: Yuan Shu received Zheng Hun and his young nephew in Huainan with great courtesy, but Zheng Hun, knowing Yuan Shu was bound to fail, soon left him and crossed the Yangtze.
text.zht: 袁術在淮南以厚禮接待鄭渾及其幼侄，但鄭渾知袁術必敗，不久便離開他渡江南下。
text.zhs: 袁术在淮南以厚礼接待郑浑及其幼侄，但郑浑知袁术必败，不久便离开他渡江南下。

text.en: Hearing of Zheng Hun's steadfast conduct, Cao Cao summoned him to his staff and promoted him to County Chief of Xiacai, County Magistrate of Shaoling, and later Intendant of Pingyi; wherever he served he made the people farm and raise silkworms and stopped them abandoning children, and they prospered.
text.zht: 曹操聞鄭渾操守堅定，召他為掾屬，後升任下蔡長、邵陵令，又任丞相掾屬、馮翊太守；他所到之處令百姓耕桑、嚴禁棄子，使民生殷實。
text.zhs: 曹操闻郑浑操守坚定，召他为掾属，后升任下蔡长、邵陵令，又任丞相掾属、冯翊太守；他所到之处令百姓耕桑、严禁弃子，使民生殷实。

text.en: Cao Cao sent Xiahou Yuan to support Zheng Hun's suppression of Liang Xing's bandits; the mountain bandits were fully pacified and Zheng Hun was transferred to Grand Administrator of Shangdang.
text.zht: 曹操派夏侯淵協助鄭渾討伐梁興等盜賊，山賊盡平，鄭渾調任上黨太守。
text.zhs: 曹操派夏侯渊协助郑浑讨伐梁兴等盗贼，山贼尽平，郑浑调任上党太守。

text.en: During the Hanzhong campaign Cao Cao appointed Zheng Hun Intendant of Jingzhao; his administration ranked foremost in transporting military grain, and Cao Cao, esteeming him all the more, recalled him to the Chancellor's staff.
text.zht: 曹操徵漢中時任命鄭渾為京兆尹，其轄區轉運軍糧居首，曹操益加器重，召回任丞相掾屬。
text.zhs: 曹操征汉中时任命郑浑为京兆尹，其辖区转运军粮居首，曹操益加器重，召回任丞相掾属。

text.en: When Cao Pi ascended the throne, Zheng Hun became Attendant Censor and Commandant of Escorting Cavalry, then Grand Administrator of Yangping and Pei State, where he built embankments and weirs and opened rice paddies.
text.zht: 曹丕稱帝后，鄭渾任侍御史、駙馬都尉，後歷任陽平、沛郡太守，在蕭、相二縣之間修築堤堰、開闢稻田。
text.zhs: 曹丕称帝后，郑浑任侍御史、驸马都尉，后历任阳平、沛郡太守，在萧、相二县之间修筑堤堰、开辟稻田。

text.en: After Zheng Hun's works in Wei Commandery made it prosperous, Cao Rui issued an edict commending him, proclaimed his achievements throughout the realm, and promoted him to Minister of Works.
text.zht: 鄭渾治魏郡成效顯著，曹叡下詔褒獎，將其政績宣示天下，並升他為大司農。
text.zhs: 郑浑治魏郡成效显著，曹叡下诏褒奖，将其政绩宣示天下，并升他为大司农。

text.en: When Liang Xing's band abducted over five thousand households and turned to plundering, Zheng Hun rebuffed advice to retreat, held the commandery, pursued the bandits and broke up their bands by making them exchange captured women.
text.zht: 梁興等人擄掠五千餘戶並劫掠地方，鄭渾不採納退守之議，堅守郡城並追剿盜賊，令其交還所掠婦女，使其部眾瓦解。
text.zhs: 梁兴等人掳掠五千余户并劫掠地方，郑浑不采纳退守之议，坚守郡城并追剿盗贼，令其交还所掠妇女，使其部众瓦解。

text.en: Liang Xing gathered his remaining followers at Fucheng, and with Xiahou Yuan's help Zheng Hun led the officials and people in the vanguard, beheading Liang Xing and his accomplices.
text.zht: 梁興聚集殘部於鄜城，鄭渾在夏侯淵協助下率官民為先鋒，斬殺梁興及其同黨。
text.zhs: 梁兴聚集残部于鄜城，郑浑在夏侯渊协助下率官民为先锋，斩杀梁兴及其同党。

text.en: Cao Cao sent Xiahou Yuan to assist the commandery in attacking Liang Xing's remnants at Fucheng.
text.zht: 曹操派夏侯淵協助郡府攻打駐鄜城的梁興殘部。
text.zhs: 曹操派夏侯渊协助郡府攻打驻鄜城的梁兴残部。

text.en: When the bandit Jin Fu abducted the Xiayang and Shaoling county officials into Mount Wei, Zheng Hun attacked, defeated him, and rescued the officials.
text.zht: 盜賊靳富劫持夏陽、邵陵二縣長吏及百姓入山，鄭渾出兵擊敗他，救出被劫官員。
text.zhs: 盗贼靳富劫持夏阳、邵陵二县长吏及百姓入山，郑浑出兵击败他，救出被劫官员。

text.en: After Zhao Qinglong killed the administrator Cheng Xiu, Zheng Hun sent brave men to take his head.
text.zht: 趙青龍殺害左內史程休後，鄭渾派勇士取其首級。
text.zhs: 赵青龙杀害左内史程休后，郑浑派勇士取其首级。

text.en: Zhao Qinglong killed Cheng Xiu, the administrator of Zuoneishi.
text.zht: 趙青龍殺害了左內史程休。
text.zhs: 赵青龙杀害了左内史程休。

text.en: A note records that Zheng Mao's son Zheng Mo, courtesy name Siyuan, upheld the family tradition and rose to Minister of Ceremonies.
text.zht: 注載鄭袤之子鄭默，字思元，承繼家風，官至太常。
text.zhs: 注载郑袤之子郑默，字思元，承继家风，官至太常。

text.en: Zheng Mo's younger brother Zheng Zhi attained ministerial office.
text.zht: 鄭默之弟鄭質官至九卿。
text.zhs: 郑默之弟郑质官至九卿。

text.en: Zheng Mo's younger brother Zheng Shu attained ministerial office.
text.zht: 鄭默之弟鄭舒官至九卿。
text.zhs: 郑默之弟郑舒官至九卿。

text.en: Zheng Mo's younger brother Zheng Xu attained ministerial office.
text.zht: 鄭默之弟鄭詡官至九卿。
text.zhs: 郑默之弟郑诩官至九卿。

text.en: Zheng Mo's son Zheng Qiu was incorruptible and upright, and served as Deputy Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
text.zht: 鄭默之子鄭球清廉正直，官至尚書僕射。
text.zhs: 郑默之子郑球清廉正直，官至尚书仆射。

text.en: Zheng Qiu's younger brother Zheng Yu served as an Imperial Secretariat.
text.zht: 鄭球之弟鄭豫官至尚書。
text.zhs: 郑球之弟郑豫官至尚书。

position.en: Scholar to the Marquis of Linzi
Staff of the Excellency of Works
Assisting Inner Gentleman of the Grand General
With Prestige Equal to the Three Excellencies

orig.zht: 鄭渾字文公，[[河南開封|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.5856252&lng=114.28191177&name=Kaifeng]]人也。高祖父衆，衆父興，皆為名儒。渾兄泰，與荀攸等謀誅董卓，為[[揚州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=9]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，卒。
orig.zhs: 郑浑字文公，[[河南开封|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.5856252&lng=114.28191177&name=Kaifeng]]人也。高祖父众，众父兴，皆为名儒。浑兄泰，与荀攸等谋诛董卓，为[[扬州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=9]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，卒。

vern.zht: 鄭渾，字文公，[[河南開封|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.5856252&lng=114.28191177&name=Kaifeng]]人。他的高祖父鄭衆，鄭衆的父親鄭興，都是著名的儒者。鄭渾的哥哥鄭泰，與荀攸等人謀劃誅殺董卓，擔任[[揚州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=9]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，後去世。
vern.zhs: 郑浑，字文公，[[河南开封|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.5856252&lng=114.28191177&name=Kaifeng]]人。他的高祖父郑众，郑众的父亲郑兴，都是著名的儒者。郑浑的哥哥郑泰，与荀攸等人谋划诛杀董卓，担任[[扬州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=9]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，后去世。

passages.en: Zheng Hun, courtesy name Wengong, was from [[Kaifeng, Henan|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.5856252&lng=114.28191177&name=Kaifeng]]. His great-great-grandfather Zheng Zhong and Zhong's father, Zheng Xing, were both renowned Confucian scholars. Zheng Hun's elder brother, Zheng Tai, plotted with Xun You and others to put Dong Zhuo to death. He later served as [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Yang Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=9]], and died early.

source.en: Xu Han Shu / Continuation of the Book of Han

張璠《漢紀》曰：泰字公業。少有才略，多謀計，知天下將亂，陰交結豪傑。家富於財，有田四百頃，而食常不足，名聞[[山東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]。舉[[孝廉|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-filial-and-incorrupt]]，三府[[辟|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]]，公車[[徵|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-summon]]，皆不就。何進輔政，[[徵|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-summon]]用名士，以泰為[[尚書侍郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-037]]，加[[奉車都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-176]]。進將誅黃門，欲召董卓為助，泰謂進曰：「董卓彊忍寡義，志欲無饜，若借之朝政，授之大事，將肆其心以危朝廷。以明公之威德，據阿衡之重任，秉意獨斷，誅除有罪，誠不待卓以為資援也。且事留變生，其鑒不遠。」又為陳時之要務，進不能用，乃棄官去。謂[[潁川|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=31]]人荀攸曰：「何公未易輔也。」

進尋見害，卓果專權，廢帝。[[關東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-pass-guandong]]義兵起，卓會議大發兵，羣寮咸憚卓，莫敢忤旨。泰恐其彊，益將難制，乃曰：「夫治在德，不在兵也。」卓不恱曰：「如此，兵無益邪？」衆人莫不變容，為泰震慄。泰乃詭辭對曰：「非以無益，以[[山東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]不足加兵也。今[[山東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]議欲起兵，州郡相連，人衆相動，非不能也。然中國自光武以來，無雞鳴狗吠之驚，百姓忘戰日乆；仲尼有言『不教民戰，是謂棄之』，雖衆不能為害，一也。明公出自西州，少為國將，閑習軍事，數踐戰場，名稱當世；以此威民，民懷懾服，二也。

袁本初公卿子弟，生處京師，體長婦人；張孟卓[[東平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=37]]長者，坐不窺堂；孔公緒能清談高論，噓枯吹生，無軍帥之才，負霜露之勤；臨鋒履刃，決敵雌雄，皆非明公敵，三也。察[[山東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]之士，力能跨馬控弦，勇等孟賁，捷齊慶忌，信有[[聊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.54725461&lng=115.90606352&name=Liaocheng]]之守，策有良平之謀；可任以偏師，責以成功，未聞有其人者，四也。就有其人，王爵不相加，婦姑位不定，各恃衆怙力，將人人棊跱，以觀成敗，不肯同心共膽，率徒旅進，五也。

[[關西|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]諸郡，北接[[上黨|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=17]]、[[太原|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=21]]、[[馮翊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]、[[扶風|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=146]]、[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]，自頃以來，數與胡戰，婦女載戟挾矛，弦弓負矢，況其悍夫；以此當[[山東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]忘戰之民，譬驅羣羊向虎狼，其勝可必，六也。且天下之權勇，今見在者不過并、涼、匈奴、屠各、湟中、義從、八種西羌，皆百姓素所畏服，而明公權以為爪牙，壯夫震慄，況小醜乎！七也。又明公之將帥，皆中表腹心，周旋日乆，自三原、硤口以來，恩信醇著，忠誠可遠任，智謀可特使，以此當[[山東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]解合之虛誕，實不相若，八也。

夫戰有三亡：以亂攻治者亡，以邪攻正者亡，以逆攻順者亡。今明公秉國政平，討夷凶宦，忠義克立；以三德待於三亡，奉辭伐罪，誰人敢禦？九也。東州有鄭康成，學該古今，儒生之所以集；[[北海|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=44]]邴根矩，清高直亮，羣士之楷式。彼諸將若詢其計畫，案典校之彊弱，燕、趙、齊、梁非不盛，終見滅於秦，吳、楚七國非不衆，而不敢踰[[滎陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84990793&lng=113.43360412&name=Xingyang]]，況今德政之赫赫，股肱之邦良，欲造亂以徼不義者，必不相然讚，成其凶謀，十也。若十事少有可采，無事徵兵以驚天下，使患役之民，相聚為非，棄德恃衆，以輕威重。」

卓乃恱，以泰為將軍，統諸軍擊[[關東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-pass-guandong]]。或謂卓曰：「鄭泰智略過人，而結謀[[山東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]，今資之士馬，使就其黨，切為明公懼之。」卓收其兵馬，留[[拜|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[議郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-182]]。後又與王允謀共誅卓，泰脫身自[[武關|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.46821825&lng=110.82115832&name=Wuguan]]走，東歸。[[後將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-115]]袁術以為[[揚州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=9]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，未至官，道卒，時年四十二。

张璠《汉纪》曰：泰字公业。少有才略，多谋计，知天下将乱，阴交结豪杰。家富于财，有田四百顷，而食常不足，名闻[[山东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]。举[[孝廉|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-filial-and-incorrupt]]，三府[[辟|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]]，公车[[征|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-summon]]，皆不就。何进辅政，[[征|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-summon]]用名士，以泰为[[尚书侍郎|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-037]]，加[[奉车都尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-176]]。进将诛黄门，欲召董卓为助，泰谓进曰：「董卓彊忍寡义，志欲无餍，若借之朝政，授之大事，将肆其心以危朝廷。以明公之威德，据阿衡之重任，秉意独断，诛除有罪，诚不待卓以为资援也。且事留变生，其鉴不远。」又为陈时之要务，进不能用，乃弃官去。谓[[颍川|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=31]]人荀攸曰：「何公未易辅也。」

进寻见害，卓果专权，废帝。[[关东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-pass-guandong]]义兵起，卓会议大发兵，群寮咸惮卓，莫敢忤旨。泰恐其彊，益将难制，乃曰：「夫治在德，不在兵也。」卓不恱曰：「如此，兵无益邪？」众人莫不变容，为泰震栗。泰乃诡辞对曰：「非以无益，以[[山东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]不足加兵也。今[[山东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]议欲起兵，州郡相连，人众相动，非不能也。然中国自光武以来，无鸡鸣狗吠之惊，百姓忘战日乆；仲尼有言『不教民战，是谓弃之』，虽众不能为害，一也。明公出自西州，少为国将，闲习军事，数践战场，名称当世；以此威民，民怀慑服，二也。

袁本初公卿子弟，生处京师，体长妇人；张孟卓[[东平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=37]]长者，坐不窥堂；孔公绪能清谈高论，嘘枯吹生，无军帅之才，负霜露之勤；临锋履刃，决敌雌雄，皆非明公敌，三也。察[[山东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]之士，力能跨马控弦，勇等孟贲，捷齐庆忌，信有[[聊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.54725461&lng=115.90606352&name=Liaocheng]]之守，策有良平之谋；可任以偏师，责以成功，未闻有其人者，四也。就有其人，王爵不相加，妇姑位不定，各恃众怙力，将人人棋跱，以观成败，不肯同心共胆，率徒旅进，五也。

[[关西|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]诸郡，北接[[上党|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=17]]、[[太原|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=21]]、[[冯翊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]、[[扶风|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=146]]、[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]，自顷以来，数与胡战，妇女载戟挟矛，弦弓负矢，况其悍夫；以此当[[山东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]忘战之民，譬驱群羊向虎狼，其胜可必，六也。且天下之权勇，今见在者不过并、凉、匈奴、屠各、湟中、义从、八种西羌，皆百姓素所畏服，而明公权以为爪牙，壮夫震栗，况小丑乎！七也。又明公之将帅，皆中表腹心，周旋日乆，自三原、硖口以来，恩信醇著，忠诚可远任，智谋可特使，以此当[[山东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]解合之虚诞，实不相若，八也。

夫战有三亡：以乱攻治者亡，以邪攻正者亡，以逆攻顺者亡。今明公秉国政平，讨夷凶宦，忠义克立；以三德待于三亡，奉辞伐罪，谁人敢御？九也。东州有郑康成，学该古今，儒生之所以集；[[北海|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=44]]邴根矩，清高直亮，群士之楷式。彼诸将若询其计划，案典校之彊弱，燕、赵、齐、梁非不盛，终见灭于秦，吴、楚七国非不众，而不敢逾[[荥阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84990793&lng=113.43360412&name=Xingyang]]，况今德政之赫赫，股肱之邦良，欲造乱以徼不义者，必不相然赞，成其凶谋，十也。若十事少有可采，无事征兵以惊天下，使患役之民，相聚为非，弃德恃众，以轻威重。」

卓乃恱，以泰为将军，统诸军击[[关东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-pass-guandong]]。或谓卓曰：「郑泰智略过人，而结谋[[山东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]，今资之士马，使就其党，切为明公惧之。」卓收其兵马，留[[拜|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[议郎|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-182]]。后又与王允谋共诛卓，泰脱身自[[武关|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.46821825&lng=110.82115832&name=Wuguan]]走，东归。[[后将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-115]]袁术以为[[扬州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=9]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，未至官，道卒，时年四十二。

張璠的《漢紀》記載：鄭泰字公業，年少時就有才能謀略，富有計謀，知道天下即將大亂，暗中結交豪傑，家中富有錢財，有四百頃田地，但糧食卻常常不夠喫，他的名聲在崤山以東地區廣爲流傳。他被舉薦爲[[孝廉|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-filial-and-incorrupt]]，三公府以公車徵召他，他都沒有去就任。何進輔佐朝政時，徵召任用有名望的士人，任命鄭泰爲[[尚書侍郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-037]]，加授[[奉車都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-176]]。何進將要誅殺宦官，想要徵召董卓前來相助。泰對何進說：“董卓強悍殘忍且缺少道義，慾望沒有止境，如果把朝政交給他，將大事交給他處理，他會肆意放縱自己的野心，從而危害朝廷。憑藉您的威望和德行，身居輔佐帝王的重要職位，您可以根據自己的意願獨自決斷，誅殺有罪之人，實在不用藉助董卓的力量。況且事情拖延就會發生變故，這方面的教訓離現在並不遠。”鄭泰又向他陳述了當時的重要事務。何進沒有采納他的建議，於是他就棄官離去，對[[潁川|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=31]]人荀攸說：“何公不容易輔佐啊。”

何進不久就被殺害了。董卓果然獨攬大權，廢除了皇帝。[[關東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-pass-guandong]]的義兵興起，董卓召開會議，大規模發兵，羣臣都畏懼董卓，沒有人敢違揹他的旨意。鄭泰擔心董卓的勢力變得更加強大之後會難以控制，就說：“治理天下依靠的是德行，而不是兵力。”董卓不高興，說：“照你這麼說，軍隊就沒有用處了嗎？”衆人沒有不變色的，爲鄭泰感到害怕戰慄。泰於是詭辯道：“不是認爲軍隊沒有用，而是認爲崤山以東的地區不值得動用兵力。現在崤山以東的人商議要起兵，各州郡相互聯合，百姓也都響應行動起來。不是說他們沒有能力起兵，然而中原地區自從光武以來，就沒有發生過戰亂，百姓忘記戰爭已經很久了。孔子曾經說過，‘不教導百姓作戰，這叫做拋棄他們。’他們雖然人數衆多，但也不能造成危害。這是第一個原因。您出身於西州，年輕時就擔任國家將領，熟悉軍事，多次親臨戰場，聲名傳於當世，憑藉這些來威懾百姓，百姓心懷畏懼而服從，這是第二個原因。

袁紹是公卿子弟，生長在京城，身材長得像婦人一樣。張孟卓是[[東平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=37]]的忠厚長者，端坐時目不斜視。孔公緒只會高談闊論，能把死的說活、活的說死，但沒有軍事統帥的才能，不能承受行軍作戰的辛苦，在戰場上衝鋒陷陣、與敵人一決勝負，這些人都不是您的對手。這是第三點。觀察崤山以東的士人，力量能騎馬射箭，勇猛如同孟賁，敏捷如同慶忌，誠信有[[聊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.54725461&lng=115.90606352&name=Liaocheng]]之守那樣的信義，謀略如同張良、陳平，可以委任他們率領一支軍隊，要求他們取得成功，但卻沒聽說有這樣的人。這是第四點。即使有這樣的人，王爵封號未授，就像婆媳一樣沒有地位的上下之分，他們各自依仗人多勢衆，將會像棋子一樣各自對峙，坐觀成敗，不肯同心協力，率領軍隊一同前進。這是第五點。

[[關西|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]各郡，北邊與[[上黨|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=17]]、[[太原|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=21]]、[[馮翊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]、[[扶風|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=146]]、[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]接壤，近來，多次與胡人交戰，婦女都能手持戟矛，拉弓背箭，何況那些強悍的男子呢。讓這些[[關西|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]士兵去對抗[[山東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]那些很久沒有經歷過戰事的百姓，就好比驅趕羊羣衝向虎狼，勝利是必然的。這是第六點。況且天下有權勢且勇猛的人，如今還存在的，不過是幷州、涼州、匈奴、屠各、湟中、義從這八種人。西羌人都是百姓向來敬畏順服的，而您暫且把他們作爲得力助手，就連身強力壯的人都會感到震驚恐懼，何況那些無能之輩呢？這是第七個原因。再者您的將帥，都是您的中表心腹，交往時間很久了，自三原狹口以來，恩德信義深厚顯著，忠誠可靠，可以委以重任，智謀出衆，可以特殊任用，以此應對[[山東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]解合的虛浮虛妄，實在無法比擬，這是第八點。

戰爭中有三種失敗的情況：用混亂的軍隊去攻打治理有序的軍隊會失敗，以邪惡的一方去攻打正義的一方會失敗，用叛逆的軍隊去攻打順應的一方會失敗。如今您執掌國家政務，平定討伐兇惡的宦官，忠義得以樹立，憑藉這三種美德來應對那三種必然滅亡的情況，奉天子之命討伐有罪之人，誰又敢抵抗呢？這是第九點。東州有位鄭康成，學問貫通古今，儒生們因此聚集；[[北海|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=44]]有位邴根矩，品行清高正直，是衆士人的楷模。那些將領如果詢問他們的計劃。根據典籍來考察雙方的強弱，當年燕國、趙國、齊國、梁國並非不強大，最終還是被秦國所滅；吳、楚等七國並非兵力不多，卻不敢越過[[滎陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84990793&lng=113.43360412&name=Xingyang]]。何況如今您的德政顯著，有得力的輔佐之臣，那些真正想製造叛亂來謀取不義之財的人，一定不會贊同他們的邪惡陰謀，這是第十點。如果這十件事稍有可採納之處，就不要無故徵兵，以免驚動天下，讓那些害怕服勞役的百姓聚集起來爲非作歹，放棄德行而依仗人多勢衆，從而輕視威嚴和重要地位。”

董卓很高興，任命鄭泰爲將軍，統領各路軍隊攻打[[關東|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-pass-guandong]]。有人對董卓說：“鄭泰智謀才略超過常人，而且與崤山以東的人合謀，如今您資助他兵馬，讓他去和他的同黨會合，我私下裏爲您感到擔憂。”董卓於是收回了他的兵馬，留下他並任命他爲[[議郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-182]]。後來鄭泰又與王允謀劃共同誅殺董卓，鄭泰從[[武關|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.46821825&lng=110.82115832&name=Wuguan]]脫身向東逃走。後來鄭泰又與王允謀劃共同誅殺董卓，鄭泰從[[武關|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.46821825&lng=110.82115832&name=Wuguan]]脫身向東逃走。[[後將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-115]]袁術任命他爲[[揚州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=9]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，他還沒到任，就在途中去世了，當時年僅四十一歲。

张璠的《汉纪》记载：郑泰字公业，年少时就有才能谋略，富有计谋，知道天下即将大乱，暗中结交豪杰，家中富有钱财，有四百顷田地，但粮食却常常不够吃，他的名声在崤山以东地区广为流传。他被举荐为[[孝廉|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-filial-and-incorrupt]]，三公府以公车征召他，他都没有去就任。何进辅佐朝政时，征召任用有名望的士人，任命郑泰为[[尚书侍郎|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-037]]，加授[[奉车都尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-176]]。何进将要诛杀宦官，想要征召董卓前来相助。泰对何进说：“董卓强悍残忍且缺少道义，欲望没有止境，如果把朝政交给他，将大事交给他处理，他会肆意放纵自己的野心，从而危害朝廷。凭借您的威望和德行，身居辅佐帝王的重要职位，您可以根据自己的意愿独自决断，诛杀有罪之人，实在不用借助董卓的力量。况且事情拖延就会发生变故，这方面的教训离现在并不远。”郑泰又向他陈述了当时的重要事务。何进没有采纳他的建议，于是他就弃官离去，对[[颍川|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=31]]人荀攸说：“何公不容易辅佐啊。”

何进不久就被杀害了。董卓果然独揽大权，废除了皇帝。[[关东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-pass-guandong]]的义兵兴起，董卓召开会议，大规模发兵，群臣都畏惧董卓，没有人敢违背他的旨意。郑泰担心董卓的势力变得更加强大之后会难以控制，就说：“治理天下依靠的是德行，而不是兵力。”董卓不高兴，说：“照你这么说，军队就没有用处了吗？”众人没有不变色的，为郑泰感到害怕战栗。泰于是诡辩道：“不是认为军队没有用，而是认为崤山以东的地区不值得动用兵力。现在崤山以东的人商议要起兵，各州郡相互联合，百姓也都响应行动起来。不是说他们没有能力起兵，然而中原地区自从光武以来，就没有发生过战乱，百姓忘记战争已经很久了。孔子曾经说过，‘不教导百姓作战，这叫做抛弃他们。’他们虽然人数众多，但也不能造成危害。这是第一个原因。您出身于西州，年轻时就担任国家将领，熟悉军事，多次亲临战场，声名传于当世，凭借这些来威慑百姓，百姓心怀畏惧而服从，这是第二个原因。

袁绍是公卿子弟，生长在京城，身材长得像妇人一样。张孟卓是[[东平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=37]]的忠厚长者，端坐时目不斜视。孔公绪只会高谈阔论，能把死的说活、活的说死，但没有军事统帅的才能，不能承受行军作战的辛苦，在战场上冲锋陷阵、与敌人一决胜负，这些人都不是您的对手。这是第三点。观察崤山以东的士人，力量能骑马射箭，勇猛如同孟贲，敏捷如同庆忌，诚信有[[聊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.54725461&lng=115.90606352&name=Liaocheng]]之守那样的信义，谋略如同张良、陈平，可以委任他们率领一支军队，要求他们取得成功，但却没听说有这样的人。这是第四点。即使有这样的人，王爵封号未授，就像婆媳一样没有地位的上下之分，他们各自依仗人多势众，将会像棋子一样各自对峙，坐观成败，不肯同心协力，率领军队一同前进。这是第五点。

[[关西|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]各郡，北边与[[上党|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=17]]、[[太原|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=21]]、[[冯翊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]、[[扶风|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=146]]、[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]接壤，近来，多次与胡人交战，妇女都能手持戟矛，拉弓背箭，何况那些强悍的男子呢。让这些[[关西|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]]士兵去对抗[[山东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]那些很久没有经历过战事的百姓，就好比驱赶羊群冲向虎狼，胜利是必然的。这是第六点。况且天下有权势且勇猛的人，如今还存在的，不过是并州、凉州、匈奴、屠各、湟中、义从这八种人。西羌人都是百姓向来敬畏顺服的，而您暂且把他们作为得力助手，就连身强力壮的人都会感到震惊恐惧，何况那些无能之辈呢？这是第七个原因。再者您的将帅，都是您的中表心腹，交往时间很久了，自三原狭口以来，恩德信义深厚显著，忠诚可靠，可以委以重任，智谋出众，可以特殊任用，以此应对[[山东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]解合的虚浮虚妄，实在无法比拟，这是第八点。

战争中有三种失败的情况：用混乱的军队去攻打治理有序的军队会失败，以邪恶的一方去攻打正义的一方会失败，用叛逆的军队去攻打顺应的一方会失败。如今您执掌国家政务，平定讨伐凶恶的宦官，忠义得以树立，凭借这三种美德来应对那三种必然灭亡的情况，奉天子之命讨伐有罪之人，谁又敢抵抗呢？这是第九点。东州有位郑康成，学问贯通古今，儒生们因此聚集；[[北海|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=44]]有位邴根矩，品行清高正直，是众士人的楷模。那些将领如果询问他们的计划。根据典籍来考察双方的强弱，当年燕国、赵国、齐国、梁国并非不强大，最终还是被秦国所灭；吴、楚等七国并非兵力不多，却不敢越过[[荥阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84990793&lng=113.43360412&name=Xingyang]]。何况如今您的德政显著，有得力的辅佐之臣，那些真正想制造叛乱来谋取不义之财的人，一定不会赞同他们的邪恶阴谋，这是第十点。如果这十件事稍有可采纳之处，就不要无故征兵，以免惊动天下，让那些害怕服劳役的百姓聚集起来为非作歹，放弃德行而依仗人多势众，从而轻视威严和重要地位。”

董卓很高兴，任命郑泰为将军，统领各路军队攻打[[关东|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-pass-guandong]]。有人对董卓说：“郑泰智谋才略超过常人，而且与崤山以东的人合谋，如今您资助他兵马，让他去和他的同党会合，我私下里为您感到担忧。”董卓于是收回了他的兵马，留下他并任命他为[[议郎|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-182]]。后来郑泰又与王允谋划共同诛杀董卓，郑泰从[[武关|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.46821825&lng=110.82115832&name=Wuguan]]脱身向东逃走。后来郑泰又与王允谋划共同诛杀董卓，郑泰从[[武关|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.46821825&lng=110.82115832&name=Wuguan]]脱身向东逃走。[[后将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-115]]袁术任命他为[[扬州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=9]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，他还没到任，就在途中去世了，当时年仅四十一岁。

Zhang Fan's Annals of Han states: Zheng Tai, courtesy name Gongye, showed considerable talent and ability from an early age. Resourceful and astute, he foresaw that the realm was heading into disorder and secretly formed ties with men of distinction. His family was wealthy and owned four hundred qing of land, yet the household never had enough food. His fame thus spread throughout [[East of the Mountain|/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]. He was recommended as [[Filial and Incorrupt|/translations/officials#glossary-filial-and-incorrupt]], [[recruited|/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]] by each of the Three Excellencies, and [[summoned|/translations/officials#glossary-summon]] to court by Official Carriage, but declined every appointment. When He Jin took charge of the government, he [[summoned|/translations/officials#glossary-summon]] eminent men to office. He appointed Zheng Tai as [[Imperial Secretariat Attendant Gentleman|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-037]] and additionally [[Commandant of Imperial Carriages|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-176]]. He Jin intended to execute the palace eunuchs and wished to summon Dong Zhuo to assist him. Zheng Tai said: "Dong Zhuo is forceful and ruthless, with little sense of righteousness, and his ambitions know no bounds. If you give him a part in court government and entrust him with great affairs, he will indulge his desires and endanger the imperial court. With Your Excellency's authority and virtue, and the weighty charge you bear as chief minister, you need only judge the matters yourself and put the guilty to death. There is truly no need to call upon Dong Zhuo for support. Moreover, if the affair is delayed, unforeseen changes may arise. The warning of a similar affair in the recent past lies close at hand." He further set out the urgent affairs of the time, but He Jin did not listen. Zheng Tai therefore resigned and departed. He told Xun You of [[Yingchuan|/maps/map-overall?admin=31]], "Lord He is not easy to assist." 

He Jin was soon killed, and Dong Zhuo did indeed seize power for himself and depose the emperor. When the righteous armies of [[East of the Pass|/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-pass-guandong]] rose, Dong Zhuo convened his officials to discuss a massive mobilisation. All the officials feared him, and none dared oppose his wishes. Zheng Tai was concerned that, if Dong Zhuo's strength increased further, he would become even harder to control. He therefore said, "Good governance rests on virtue, not on arms." Dong Zhuo was displeased. "Then are troops of no use?" Everyone's expression changed, and they feared for Zheng Tai. Zheng Tai then answered craftily, saying, "I do not mean that troops are useless, only that [[East of the Mountain|/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]] is not worth sending them against. First, The men of [[East of the Mountain|/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]] now propose to raise armies. Their provinces and commanderies are linked, and their people will incite one another to action. It is not that such a chain of events will not occur. Yet since the time of Emperor Guangwu, the Illustrious Martial Emperor, the central lands have known no alarm even at the crowing of cocks and barking of dogs. The people have long forgotten warfare. Confucius said, 'To send an untrained people into battle is to cast them away.' However numerous they may be, they can do no harm. Second, Your Excellency comes from the western provinces. From an early age you served as a general of the state, became thoroughly practised in military affairs, and repeatedly took the field. Your name is renowned in this age. The people are awed by your might and submit in fear. 

Third, Yuan Benchu is the son of a family of high ministers. Born and raised in the capital, he grew up among women. Zhang Mengzhuo is merely a respectable gentleman of [[Dongping State|/maps/map-overall?admin=37]], one who sits decorously and never casts his gaze about heedlessly. Kong Gongxu can engage in pure conversation and lofty discourse, with words that can revive the fallen and bring down the flourishing, but he lacks a commander's ability and cannot endure the hardships of frost and dew. When it comes to facing spearpoints, braving blades, and deciding victory or defeat, none is Your Excellency's match. Fourth, consider the men of [[East of the Mountain|/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]. Is there among them anyone who can mount a horse and draw a bow, whose courage equals Meng Ben's and whose swiftness matches Qing Ji's; whose fidelity could sustain the defence of [[Liaocheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.54725461&lng=115.90606352&name=Liaocheng]], and whose strategies are worthy of Zhang Liang and Chen Ping; who could be entrusted with a detached force and charged with securing victory? I have heard of no such man. Fifth, even if such men exist, no royal title has been conferred upon any one of them, and their respective ranks remain unsettled. Each relies on the strength of his own following, and they will stand apart like pieces on a chessboard, watching to see who succeeds and who fails. They will be unwilling to act with one heart and one resolve, or to lead their forces forward together. 

Sixth, the commanderies of [[West of the Pass|/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-pass-guanxi]], extending north to [[Shangdang|/maps/map-overall?admin=17]], [[Taiyuan|/maps/map-overall?admin=21]], [[Pingyi|/maps/map-overall?admin=151]], [[Fufeng|/maps/map-overall?admin=146]], and [[Anding|/maps/map-overall?admin=152]], have repeatedly fought the Hu in recent years. Even their women carry halberds, tuck spears beneath their arms, string bows, and bear arrows, to say nothing of their fierce men. To pit them against the people of [[East of the Mountain|/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]], who have long forgotten warfare, would be like driving a flock of sheep before tigers and wolves. Victory would be certain. Seventh, the strongest and bravest forces now under heaven are found only in Bing and Liang provinces, among the Xiongnu, the Tuge, the Huangzhong, the Yichong, and the Eight Tribes of the Western Qiang. These are all peoples whom the common folk have long feared and obeyed, and Your Excellency commands them as your claws and fangs. Even stout-hearted men tremble before them, to say nothing of this petty rabble. Eighth, Your Excellency's commanders are all kinsmen and trusted intimates who have served with you for many years. Ever since Sanyuan and Xiakou, your favour and good faith towards them have been clearly demonstrated. Their loyalty makes them worthy of distant commands, and their resourcefulness fits them for independent missions. Compared with the empty bluster of [[East of the Mountain|/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]'s loose confederacy, they are truly of a different order. 

Ninth, there are three causes of defeat in war: when disorder attacks order, wickedness attacks righteousness, and rebellion attacks rightful authority. Your Excellency now directs the government of the state, has put down and punished the vicious eunuchs, and has established loyalty and righteousness. Possessing these three virtues, you confront enemies who embody all three causes of defeat. If you proclaim their crimes and march forth to punish the guilty, who will dare resist? Tenth, in the eastern provinces there is Zheng Kangcheng, whose learning encompasses antiquity and the present, and around whom scholars gather. In [[Beihai State|/maps/map-overall?admin=44]] there is Bing Genju, pure, principled, upright, and sincere, a model for all scholars. If those commanders consult such men on their plans and examine the precedents of antiquity to compare strength and weakness, they will see that Yan, Zhao, Qi, and Liang, though powerful, were all eventually destroyed by Qin, while Wu, Chu, and the other seven kingdoms, though populous, did not dare advance beyond [[Xingyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84990793&lng=113.43360412&name=Xingyang]]. How much less, under Your Excellency's illustrious and virtuous government, would these worthy pillars of the realm approve of those who seek to create disorder in pursuit of injustice, encourage their actions, and help them accomplish their wicked designs? If even a few of these ten considerations are worth adopting, there is no need to raise troops and alarm the realm. To do so would only cause people already burdened by service to gather and make trouble, forsaking virtue to rely on mere numbers and using their paltry strength to diminish the weight of your authority." 

Dong Zhuo was pleased. He appointed Zheng Tai a general and placed him in command of the armies sent against [[East of the Pass|/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-pass-guandong]]. Someone then told Dong Zhuo, "Zheng Tai's intelligence and strategic ability surpass those of ordinary men, and he has ties and plans with [[East of the Mountain|/translations/officials#glossary-east-of-the-mountain-shandong]]. If you now provide him with troops and horses and allow him to join his associates, I greatly fear for Your Excellency." Dong Zhuo therefore took away Zheng Tai's troops and horses, kept him at court, and [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] him [[Gentleman Consultant|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-182]]. Zheng Tai later conspired with Wang Yun to kill Dong Zhuo. He escaped through [[Wuguan|/maps/map-overall?lat=33.46821825&lng=110.82115832&name=Wuguan]] and fled east. Yuan Shu, [[General of the Rear|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-115]], appointed him [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Yang Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=9]], but he died on the way before taking office. He was forty-two.

orig.zht: 渾將泰小子袤避難[[淮南|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=24]]，袁術賔禮甚厚。渾知術必敗。時華歆為[[豫章|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=71]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，素與泰善，渾乃渡江投歆。太祖聞其篤行，召為掾，復[[遷|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]][[下蔡|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.71353337&lng=116.7293608&name=Xiacai]][[長|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-089]]、[[邵陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.60565556&lng=114.15360904&name=Shaoling]][[令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]。天下未定，民皆剽輕，不念產殖；其生子無以相活，率皆不舉。渾所在奪其漁獵之具，課使耕桑，又兼開稻田，重去子之法。民初畏罪，後稍豐給，無不舉贍；所育男女，多以鄭為字。[[辟|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]]為[[丞相|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]掾屬，[[遷|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]左[[馮翊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]。
orig.zhs: 浑将泰小子袤避难[[淮南|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=24]]，袁术賔礼甚厚。浑知术必败。时华歆为[[豫章|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=71]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，素与泰善，浑乃渡江投歆。太祖闻其笃行，召为掾，复[[迁|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]][[下蔡|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.71353337&lng=116.7293608&name=Xiacai]][[长|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-089]]、[[邵陵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.60565556&lng=114.15360904&name=Shaoling]][[令|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]。天下未定，民皆剽轻，不念产殖；其生子无以相活，率皆不举。浑所在夺其渔猎之具，课使耕桑，又兼开稻田，重去子之法。民初畏罪，后稍丰给，无不举赡；所育男女，多以郑为字。[[辟|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]]为[[丞相|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]掾属，[[迁|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]左[[冯翊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]。

vern.zht: 鄭渾帶着鄭泰的小兒子鄭袤到[[淮南|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=24]]避難，袁術以賓客之禮相待，非常優厚。鄭渾知道袁術必定會失敗。當時華歆任[[豫章|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=71]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，素來與鄭泰交好，鄭渾於是渡過長江投靠華歆。太祖聽說他品行敦厚，徵召他擔任掾，後又歷任[[下蔡|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.71353337&lng=116.7293608&name=Xiacai]]縣[[長|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-089]]、[[邵陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.60565556&lng=114.15360904&name=Shaoling]]縣[[令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]。當時天下還沒有安定，百姓都剽悍輕率，不關心生產增殖；生下孩子卻無力養活的，都丟棄不養。鄭渾每到一處，就收繳當地百姓的漁獵工具，督促他們耕田種桑，又同時開墾稻田，加重對丟棄子女行爲的處罰。起初百姓害怕獲罪，後來生活逐漸富裕，沒有不養育子女的；所養育的男女，大多用“鄭”字做名字。後來鄭渾被徵召爲[[丞相|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]掾屬，升任左[[馮翊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]。
vern.zhs: 郑浑带着郑泰的小儿子郑袤到[[淮南|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=24]]避难，袁术以宾客之礼相待，非常优厚。郑浑知道袁术必定会失败。当时华歆任[[豫章|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=71]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，素来与郑泰交好，郑浑于是渡过长江投靠华歆。太祖听说他品行敦厚，征召他担任掾，后又历任[[下蔡|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.71353337&lng=116.7293608&name=Xiacai]]县[[长|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-089]]、[[邵陵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.60565556&lng=114.15360904&name=Shaoling]]县[[令|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]。当时天下还没有安定，百姓都剽悍轻率，不关心生产增殖；生下孩子却无力养活的，都丢弃不养。郑浑每到一处，就收缴当地百姓的渔猎工具，督促他们耕田种桑，又同时开垦稻田，加重对丢弃子女行为的处罚。起初百姓害怕获罪，后来生活逐渐富裕，没有不养育子女的；所养育的男女，大多用“郑”字做名字。后来郑浑被征召为[[丞相|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]掾属，升任左[[冯翊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]。

passages.en: Zheng Hun took Zheng Tai's young son Zheng Mao with him and sought refuge in [[Huainan|/maps/map-overall?admin=24]], where Yuan Shu received them with great courtesy. Knowing that Yuan Shu was bound to fail, Zheng Hun crossed the Yangtze and joined Hua Xin, then [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Yuzhang|/maps/map-overall?admin=71]], who had long been a friend of his elder brother Zheng Tai. When Cao Cao (posthumously honoured as Taizu, the Grand Progenitor) heard of Zheng Hun's steadfast conduct, he summoned him to serve as his staff, then [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] him later to [[County Chief|/translations/officials/regional#counties-089]] of [[Xiacai|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.71353337&lng=116.7293608&name=Xiacai]] and [[County Magistrate|/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]] of [[Shaoling|/maps/map-overall?lat=33.60565556&lng=114.15360904&name=Shaoling]]. The realm was not yet settled, and the people were restless and improvident, giving no thought to farming or production. When they had children they could not support, most left them to die. Wherever Zheng Hun served, he confiscated their fishing and hunting equipment and required them to farm and raise silkworms. He also opened paddy fields and imposed severe penalties for abandoning children. At first, the people obeyed out of fear of punishment, but in time they grew prosperous, and their households became well provided for. All were then able to raise and support their children, and many named the sons and daughters born to them "Zheng". Zheng Hun was later [[recruited|/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]] to the [[Chancellor|/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]'s staff and [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to Intendant of [[Pingyi|/maps/map-overall?admin=151]].

orig.zht: 時梁興等略吏民五千餘家為寇鈔，諸縣不能禦，皆恐懼，寄治郡下。議者悉以為當移就險，渾曰：「興等破散，竄在山阻。雖有隨者，率脅從耳。今當廣開降路，宣喻恩信。而保險自守，此示弱也。」乃聚歛吏民，治城郭，為守禦之備。遂發民逐賊，明賞罰，與要誓，其所得獲，十以七賞。百姓大恱，皆願捕賊，多得婦女、財物。賊之失妻子者，皆還求降。渾責其得他婦女，然後還其妻子，於是轉相寇盜，黨與離散。
orig.zhs: 时梁兴等略吏民五千余家为寇钞，诸县不能御，皆恐惧，寄治郡下。议者悉以为当移就险，浑曰：「兴等破散，窜在山阻。虽有随者，率胁从耳。今当广开降路，宣喻恩信。而保险自守，此示弱也。」乃聚歛吏民，治城郭，为守御之备。遂发民逐贼，明赏罚，与要誓，其所得获，十以七赏。百姓大恱，皆愿捕贼，多得妇女、财物。贼之失妻子者，皆还求降。浑责其得他妇女，然后还其妻子，于是转相寇盗，党与离散。

vern.zht: 當時梁興等人把五千多家官民擄去，強迫他們充當賊寇、進行抄掠；各縣不能抵禦，都很恐懼，把治所寄設在郡城。議事的人都認爲應當轉移到險要的地方。鄭渾說：“梁興等人已經敗散，逃竄在山區險阻之間；即使有跟隨的人，也大都只是被脅迫跟從的。現在應當廣開投降的門路，宣示恩德信義；如果據守險要自保，這反而是向敵人示弱。”於是鄭渾召集官民，修治城牆，做好守禦的準備。接着徵發百姓追擊賊寇，明確賞罰，與百姓立下約誓：他們所繳獲的人口和財物，十分之七賞給他們。百姓非常高興，都願意捕捉賊寇，因此大量獲得婦女和財物。賊寇中失去妻子兒女的人，都回來請求投降。鄭渾責令他們捉來其他婦女，然後才把他們的妻子兒女還給他們；於是這些人轉而互相劫掠，黨羽也就離散了。
vern.zhs: 当时梁兴等人把五千多家官民掳去，强迫他们充当贼寇、进行抄掠；各县不能抵御，都很恐惧，把治所寄设在郡城。议事的人都认为应当转移到险要的地方。郑浑说：“梁兴等人已经败散，逃窜在山区险阻之间；即使有跟随的人，也大都只是被胁迫跟从的。现在应当广开投降的门路，宣示恩德信义；如果据守险要自保，这反而是向敌人示弱。”于是郑浑召集官民，修治城墙，做好守御的准备。接着征发百姓追击贼寇，明确赏罚，与百姓立下约誓：他们所缴获的人口和财物，十分之七赏给他们。百姓非常高兴，都愿意捕捉贼寇，因此大量获得妇女和财物。贼寇中失去妻子儿女的人，都回来请求投降。郑浑责令他们捉来其他妇女，然后才把他们的妻子儿女还给他们；于是这些人转而互相劫掠，党羽也就离散了。

passages.en: At the time, Liang Xing and his men had abducted more than five thousand households of officials and commoners and turned to plundering. Unable to withstand them, the county officials fled in fear and administered their counties from the commandery seat. The counsellors all urged a withdrawal to defensible ground, but Zheng Hun said, "Liang Xing and his men have been defeated and scattered, and now hide in the mountains. Though some still follow them, most have been coerced. We should open every avenue to surrender and proclaim our clemency and good faith. To retreat to strong ground and stand on the defensive would only reveal weakness." He assembled the officials and people, repaired the city walls, and prepared the defences. He then mobilised the people to pursue the bandits, clearly set out rewards and punishments, and pledged to them that seven-tenths of whatever they captured would be theirs. The people were delighted and eagerly hunted the bandits, seizing many women and much property. Those bandits who had lost their wives and children came to seek surrender. Zheng Hun required each to hand over women he had seized from others before returning his own wife and children. The bandits then began preying on one another, and their bands fell apart.

orig.zht: 又遣吏民有恩信者，分布山谷告喻，出者相繼，乃使諸縣長吏各還本治以安集之。興等懼，將餘衆聚[[鄜城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.60832708&lng=109.61482388&name=Fucheng]]。太祖使夏侯淵就助郡擊之，渾率吏民前登，斬興及其支黨。又賊靳富等，脅將[[夏陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.39983275&lng=110.38547776&name=Xiayang]][[長|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-089]]、[[邵陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.60565556&lng=114.15360904&name=Shaoling]][[令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]][^1]并其吏民入磑山，渾復討擊破富等，獲二縣長吏，將其所略還。及趙青龍者，殺左內史程休，渾聞，遣壯士就梟其首。前後歸附四千餘家，由是山賊皆平，民安產業。[[轉|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]]為[[上黨|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=17]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。
orig.zhs: 又遣吏民有恩信者，分布山谷告喻，出者相继，乃使诸县长吏各还本治以安集之。兴等惧，将余众聚[[鄜城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.60832708&lng=109.61482388&name=Fucheng]]。太祖使夏侯渊就助郡击之，浑率吏民前登，斩兴及其支党。又贼靳富等，胁将[[夏阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.39983275&lng=110.38547776&name=Xiayang]][[长|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-089]]、[[邵陵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.60565556&lng=114.15360904&name=Shaoling]][[令|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]][^1]并其吏民入硙山，浑复讨击破富等，获二县长吏，将其所略还。及赵青龙者，杀左内史程休，浑闻，遣壮士就枭其首。前后归附四千余家，由是山贼皆平，民安产业。[[转|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]]为[[上党|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=17]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。

vern.zht: 鄭渾又派遣有恩德信義的吏民，分散到山谷中宣告曉諭，出來的人接連不斷，於是讓各縣的長吏各自回到原來的治所，來安撫聚集他們。梁興等人恐懼，率領餘衆聚集在[[鄜城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.60832708&lng=109.61482388&name=Fucheng]]。太祖派夏侯淵前往協助郡中攻擊他們，鄭渾率領吏民率先登城，斬殺了梁興及其黨羽。又有賊寇靳富等，挾持[[夏陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.39983275&lng=110.38547776&name=Xiayang]][[縣長|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-089]]、[[邵陵|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.60565556&lng=114.15360904&name=Shaoling]]縣[[令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]][^1]以及他們的吏民進入磑山，鄭渾又討擊打敗靳富等，救回二縣長吏，把他們所擄掠的人帶回。又有趙青龍，殺死左內史程休，鄭渾聽說後，派遣壯士前往砍下趙青龍的首級。前後歸附的有四千餘家，從此山賊都被平定，百姓安於產業。鄭渾轉任[[上黨|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=17]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。
vern.zhs: 郑浑又派遣有恩德信义的吏民，分散到山谷中宣告晓谕，出来的人接连不断，于是让各县的长吏各自回到原来的治所，来安抚聚集他们。梁兴等人恐惧，率领余众聚集在[[鄜城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.60832708&lng=109.61482388&name=Fucheng]]。太祖派夏侯渊前往协助郡中攻击他们，郑浑率领吏民率先登城，斩杀了梁兴及其党羽。又有贼寇靳富等，挟持[[夏阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.39983275&lng=110.38547776&name=Xiayang]][[县长|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-089]]、[[邵陵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.60565556&lng=114.15360904&name=Shaoling]]县[[令|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]][^1]以及他们的吏民进入硙山，郑浑又讨击打败靳富等，救回二县长吏，把他们所掳掠的人带回。又有赵青龙，杀死左内史程休，郑浑听说后，派遣壮士前往砍下赵青龙的首级。前后归附的有四千余家，从此山贼都被平定，百姓安于产业。郑浑转任[[上党|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=17]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。

passages.en: Zheng Hun also sent trusted and respected officials and local men throughout the hills and valleys to proclaim his intentions. People emerged in succession, whereupon he ordered the senior officials of each county to return to their posts and resettle them. Liang Xing and the others, now fearful, gathered their remaining followers at [[Fucheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.60832708&lng=109.61482388&name=Fucheng]]. Cao Cao sent Xiahou Yuan to assist the commandery in attacking them. Zheng Hun led the officials and people in the vanguard, beheading Liang Xing and his accomplices. Thereafter, the bandits Jin Fu and others abducted the [[Xiayang|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.39983275&lng=110.38547776&name=Xiayang]] [[County Chief|/translations/officials/regional#counties-089]] and the [[Shaoling|/maps/map-overall?lat=33.60565556&lng=114.15360904&name=Shaoling]] [[County Magistrate|/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]],[^1] together with their officials and people, and took them into Mount Wei. Zheng Hun again attacked, defeated Jin Fu and his men, rescued the officials of both counties, and brought back those who had been abducted. Later, a man named Zhao Qinglong killed Cheng Xiu, the administrator of Zuoneishi. On hearing of this, Zheng Hun sent brave men to take his head. In total, more than four thousand households submitted to him. The mountain bandits were thus completely pacified, and the people could pursue their livelihoods in peace. Zheng Hun was [[transferred|/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]] to serve as [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Shangdang|/maps/map-overall?admin=17]].

orig.zht: 太祖征[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，以渾為[[京兆|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=142]]尹。渾以百姓新集，為制移居之法，使兼複者與單輕者相伍，溫信者與孤老為比，勤稼穡，明禁令，以發姦者。由是民安於農，而盜賊止息。及大軍入[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，運轉軍糧為最。又遣民田[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，無逃亡者。太祖益嘉之，復入為[[丞相|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]掾。文帝即位，為[[侍御史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#censorate-049]]，加[[駙馬都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-177]]，[[遷|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]][[陽平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=161]]、[[沛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=26]]郡二[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。郡界下溼，患水澇，百姓饑乏。渾於[[蕭|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.23551368&lng=116.90273838&name=Xiao]]、[[相|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.9834785&lng=116.66258134&name=Xiang]]二縣界，興陂遏，開稻田。

vern.zht: 太祖征討[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，任命鄭渾爲[[京兆|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=142]]尹。鄭渾因百姓剛剛聚集，爲他們制定移居的法規，讓家口衆多的人家與孤單力弱的人家編成一伍，讓溫和誠信的人家與孤老爲鄰，督促他們勤於耕作，申明禁令，用來揭發奸邪之人。從此百姓安心務農，盜賊止息。等到大軍進入[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，他轉運軍糧的成績最爲突出。他又派遣百姓到[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]種田，沒有人逃亡。太祖更加讚許他，他又入朝擔任[[丞相|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]掾。文帝即位後，他任[[侍御史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#censorate-049]]，加[[駙馬都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-177]]，調任[[陽平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=161]]、[[沛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=26]]郡二郡[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。這兩郡地勢低下潮溼，常患水澇，百姓飢餓睏乏。鄭渾在[[蕭|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.23551368&lng=116.90273838&name=Xiao]]、[[相|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.9834785&lng=116.66258134&name=Xiang]]二縣交界處，興修陂塘、堤堰，開闢稻田。
vern.zhs: 太祖征讨[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，任命郑浑为[[京兆|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=142]]尹。郑浑因百姓刚刚聚集，为他们制定移居的法规，让家口众多的人家与孤单力弱的人家编成一伍，让温和诚信的人家与孤老为邻，督促他们勤于耕作，申明禁令，用来揭发奸邪之人。从此百姓安心务农，盗贼止息。等到大军进入[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，他转运军粮的成绩最为突出。他又派遣百姓到[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]种田，没有人逃亡。太祖更加赞许他，他又入朝担任[[丞相|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]掾。文帝即位后，他任[[侍御史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#censorate-049]]，加[[驸马都尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-177]]，调任[[阳平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=161]]、[[沛|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=26]]郡二郡[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。这两郡地势低下潮湿，常患水涝，百姓饥饿困乏。郑浑在[[萧|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.23551368&lng=116.90273838&name=Xiao]]、[[相|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.9834785&lng=116.66258134&name=Xiang]]二县交界处，兴修陂塘、堤堰，开辟稻田。

passages.en: When Cao Cao campaigned in [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]], he appointed Zheng Hun Intendant of [[Jingzhao|/maps/map-overall?admin=142]].As the people had only recently resettled, Zheng Hun established a system for their settlement: large and populous households were placed alongside the small and weak, while the kind and trustworthy were made neighbours to orphans and the elderly. He encouraged agriculture and made the prohibitions clear, thereby helping to expose wrongdoers. The people thus settled peacefully to farming, and banditry ceased. When the main army entered [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]], Zheng Hun's administration ranked foremost in transporting military grain. He also sent people to cultivate land in [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]], and none fled. Cao Cao esteemed him all the more and recalled him to serve once more on the [[Chancellor|/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]'s staff. When Cao Pi (posthumously honoured as Emperor Wen, the Civil Emperor) ascended the throne, Zheng Hun became [[Attendant Censor|/translations/officials/departments#censorate-049]] and additionally [[Commandant of Escorting Cavalry|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-177]]. He was later [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] successively to [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Yangping|/maps/map-overall?admin=161]] and [[Pei State|/maps/map-overall?admin=26]]. These commanderies were low-lying and damp and frequently suffered from flooding, leaving the people short of food. Along the border between [[Xiao|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.23551368&lng=116.90273838&name=Xiao]] and [[Xiang|/maps/map-overall?lat=33.9834785&lng=116.66258134&name=Xiang]] counties, Zheng Hun constructed embankments and weirs and opened up rice paddies.

orig.zht: 郡人皆以為不便，渾曰：「地勢洿下，宜溉灌，終有魚稻經乆之利，此豐民之本也。」遂躬率吏民，興立功夫，一冬閒皆成。比年大收，頃畒歲增，租入倍常，民賴其利，刻石頌之，號曰[[鄭陂|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.24712016&lng=116.75632163&name=Zheng%20Reservoir]]。[[轉|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]]為[[山陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=34]]、[[魏|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=162]]郡[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，其治放此。又以郡下百姓，苦乏材木，乃課樹榆為籬，並益樹五果；榆皆成藩，五果豐實。入[[魏|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=162]]郡界，村落齊整如一，民得財足用饒。明帝聞之，下詔稱述，布告天下，[[遷|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]將作大匠。渾清素在公，妻子不免於饑寒。及卒，以子崇為郎中。
orig.zhs: 郡人皆以为不便，浑曰：「地势洿下，宜溉灌，终有鱼稻经乆之利，此丰民之本也。」遂躬率吏民，兴立功夫，一冬闲皆成。比年大收，顷畒岁增，租入倍常，民赖其利，刻石颂之，号曰[[郑陂|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.24712016&lng=116.75632163&name=Zheng%20Reservoir]]。[[转|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]]为[[山阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=34]]、[[魏|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=162]]郡[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，其治放此。又以郡下百姓，苦乏材木，乃课树榆为篱，并益树五果；榆皆成藩，五果丰实。入[[魏|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=162]]郡界，村落齐整如一，民得财足用饶。明帝闻之，下诏称述，布告天下，[[迁|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]将作大匠。浑清素在公，妻子不免于饥寒。及卒，以子崇为郎中。

vern.zht: 郡中的人都認爲這樣做不方便。鄭渾說：“這裏地勢低窪，適宜灌溉，最終會有魚、稻方面的長久利益，這是使百姓富裕的根本。”於是他親自率領吏民，興建工程，一個冬天的農閒時間全部完成。此後連年大獲豐收，耕種的田畝逐年增加，租稅收入比往常成倍增長，百姓依賴這些利益，刻石頌揚他，稱它爲[[鄭陂|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.24712016&lng=116.75632163&name=Zheng%20Reservoir]]。後來轉任[[山陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=34]]、[[魏|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=162]]郡[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，他的治理也仿照這樣。又因爲郡下的百姓苦於缺乏木材，他便督促種植榆樹作爲籬笆，並加種五種果樹；榆樹都長成了藩籬，五種果樹果實豐實。進入[[魏|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=162]]郡境內，村落整齊如一，百姓財物充足、用度豐饒。明帝聽說後，下詔稱讚表彰，佈告天下，升任他爲將作大匠。鄭渾爲官清廉樸素，妻子兒女不免於飢寒。等到他去世後，他的兒子鄭崇被任命爲郎中。

passages.en: The people of the commandery all considered the scheme impracticable. Zheng Hun said, "The land is low-lying and well suited to irrigation. In time, fish and rice will bring lasting profit. This is the foundation of the people's prosperity." He personally led the officials and people in undertaking the work, and it was completed within a single winter. In successive years the harvests were abundant, the cultivated acreage increased annually, and tax receipts doubled. The people benefited from the works and carved a stone inscription in his praise, naming it the [[Zheng Reservoir|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.24712016&lng=116.75632163&name=Zheng%20Reservoir]]. Zheng Hun was [[transferred|/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]] to serve as [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Shanyang|/maps/map-overall?admin=34]] and later of [[Wei|/maps/map-overall?admin=162]] Commandery, where he governed on the same principles. As the people suffered from a shortage of timber, he required them to plant elms for hedges, together with five other kinds of fruit trees. The elms grew into sturdy barriers, while the fruit trees yielded abundantly. On entering [[Wei|/maps/map-overall?admin=162]] Commandery, one found every village neat and orderly, and the people prosperous and well provided for. When Cao Rui (posthumously honoured as Emperor Ming, the Radiant Emperor) heard of this, he issued an edict commending Zheng Hun and proclaimed his achievements throughout the realm. Zheng Hun was [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to Minister of Works. Zheng Hun remained incorruptible and frugal in office, to the point that even his wife and children suffered from hunger and cold. After his death, his son Zheng Chong was appointed a Court Gentleman.

source.en: Jin Yang Qiu / Annals of Jin (Sun Sheng)

annotations.en: The Jin Yang Qiu / Annals of Jin states: Zheng Tai's son Zheng Mao had the courtesy name Linshu. Zheng Tai was good friends with Hua Xin and Xun You. On seeing Zheng Mao, Hua Xin said, "Zheng Gongye will not perish after all!" Zheng Mao began his career as [[Scholar|/translations/officials/regional#states-087]] to the Marquis of [[Linzi|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]] and was eventually [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to [[Household Counsellor|/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-119]]. In the seventh year of Taishi, he was appointed [[Excellency of Works|/translations/officials/ministers#three-excellencies-105]], but firmly declined the office. He died at home. His son Zheng Mo, courtesy name Siyuan. The *Appraisals of the Lords of Jin* states: Zheng Mo upheld his family tradition and was renowned for his steadfast simplicity, eventually rising to [[Minister of Ceremonies|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-120]]. His younger brothers Zheng Zhi, Zheng Shu, and Zheng Xu all attained ministerial office. Zheng Mo's son Zheng Qiu was incorruptible and upright, with sound judgement. He served as [[Deputy Director of the Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]] and oversaw official appointments. Zheng Qiu's younger brother Zheng Yu served as an [[Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]].

source.en: Jin Zhugong Zan / Appraisal of Officials of Jin (Fu Chang)

vern.zht: 《晉諸公贊》記載：鄭默恪守家業，以樸實忠厚著稱，官至[[太常|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-120]]。他的弟弟質、舒、詡，都擔任了卿的官職。鄭默的兒子鄭球，爲人清廉正直有見識，擔任[[尚書右僕射|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]]，兼管選拔官吏之事。鄭球的弟弟鄭豫，擔任[[尚書|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。
vern.zhs: 《晋诸公赞》记载：郑默恪守家业，以朴实忠厚著称，官至[[太常|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-120]]。他的弟弟质、舒、诩，都担任了卿的官职。郑默的儿子郑球，为人清廉正直有见识，担任[[尚书右仆射|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]]，兼管选拔官吏之事。郑球的弟弟郑豫，担任[[尚书|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。

annotations.en: The Jin Zhugong Zan / Appraisal of Officials of Jin states: Zheng Mo upheld his family tradition and was renowned for his steadfast simplicity, eventually rising to [[Minister of Ceremonies|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-120]]. His younger brothers Zheng Zhi, Zheng Shu, and Zheng Xu all attained ministerial office. Zheng Mo's son Zheng Qiu was incorruptible and upright, with sound judgement. He served as [[Deputy Director of the Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-032]] and oversaw official appointments. Zheng Qiu's younger brother Zheng Yu served as an [[Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]].
